---
title: "Player testing and training"
---

Individual players can work directly with Base Running Science™ for assessment, training and development. Your programme is adapted to your needs, available facilities and playing schedule. Coaching supports performance development; medical diagnosis and treatment are outside the service.

## Local testing and coaching

| Service | Included scope |
|---|---|
| I01 Individual assessment | Up to 90 minutes of local timing/video testing, linear and curvilinear measures, written report and 30-minute discussion. |
| I02 Retest | Up to 60 minutes using a usable comparable baseline protocol, comparison report and 20-minute review. |
| I03 Private training session | One local 60-minute coaching session, preparation and brief training record. Initial assessment is separate. |
| I04 Eight-week local programme | Initial assessment, eight private 60-minute sessions, individualized programme, four video reviews of up to five minutes of footage each, and final retest. |

For I04, any credit for an existing Base Running Science™ baseline assessment is agreed in your quote. Local programmes do not include travel or residential presence. The quote confirms the venue and any field-hire or additional technology costs.

## Visiting and residential support

| Service | Included scope |
|---|---|
| V01 Five-day visiting intensive | One player and location; initial assessment; up to five scheduled coaching sessions of up to 90 minutes; individualized programme and closing review. No long-term retest. |
| V02 Eight-week residential engagement | One player/location; up to five scheduled service days per week and four client-work hours per day; testing, coaching, analysis, programming and final retest. Nonexclusive. |
| V03 Exclusive residential engagement | A separately negotiated eight-week engagement with written limits on competing clients, territory, dates and availability. Replaces V02. |

Residential work hours include analysis and programming, not four hours of daily physical training. Training frequency reflects readiness and recovery. Rest days and off-duty time are protected; no programme includes 24-hour availability.

**Travel time T01.** Reserved travel days of up to eight hours are included as a separate item in your quote. Flights, private accommodation, ground transport, meals and agreed home visits are separately approved and funded. Additional long-haul time and changes of location require agreement. The residential fee reflects the extended onsite commitment and time away from home.

## Your pathway

Start with your performance question and a discussion of your baseline. Agree a suitable assessment or programme, receive feedback, and use reassessment to evaluate change. If a team or agent pays, agree who can receive your reports before information is shared.

Request a tailored quote for your scope, location and schedule. [Request player support](contact.qmd).
